2126283108185973202.en_summary: $NVDA - NVIDIA BLACKWELL CHIPS FOUND AT CHINESE DATA CENTER LINKED TO MEGASPEED. Two Chinese companies installed restricted Nvidia Blackwell hardware at a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang and Megaspeed, according to Bloomberg. Regulatory filings identify a GB300 NVL72 rack and a GB200 server, with the GB300 pledged as collateral for a $14 million loan. The discovery raises fresh questions about U.S. semiconductor export-control enforcement. How the chips reached China remains unclear. Bloomberg found no evidence that Megaspeed itself diverted the hardware, and the company denies wrongdoing.
2126283108185973202.zh_summary: $NVDA - NVIDIA BLACKWELL 晶片在與 MEGASPEED 相關的中國數據中心被發現。根據 Bloomberg，兩家中國公司在與 Alice Huang 和 Megaspeed 相關的上海數據中心安裝了受限制的 Nvidia Blackwell 硬件。監管文件識別出一個 GB300 NVL72 機架和一個 GB200 伺服器，其中 GB300 被作為 1400 萬美元貸款的抵押品。這一發現對美國半導體出口管制執法提出新疑問。晶片如何到達中國仍不清楚。Bloomberg 未發現 Megaspeed 本身轉移硬件的證據，公司否認有不當行為。

ticker_notes.NVDA: Blackwell 硬件在上海數據中心被發現，GB300 作為 1400 萬美元貸款抵押
